title: Australia-based Myriota, which provides low-cost, low-power satellite connectivity for industrial IoT, raised roughly $40M in the first close of its Series C (Rhiannon Hoyle/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Rhiannon Hoyle / Wall Street Journal: Australia-based Myriota, which provides low-cost, low-power satellite connectivity for industrial IoT, raised roughly $40M in the first close of its Series C — Myriota raises roughly $40 million in a first close of a Series C round to hire staff and scale satellite constellation
